sharedRules.name: Cyberwarfare Weapons
sharedRules.description:
Cyberwarfare attacks do not cause Hull Damage or Critical Hits. Instead, if the attack equals or exceeds the target’s Damage Rating, choose a Targeted Strike area and roll a D6 on the relevant table to determine the effect caused. If the attack equals or exceeds the target’s Critical Rating, choose TWO Targeted Strike areas and roll a D6 on each table to determine the effect caused.

If the target of a Cyberwarfare Attack is a non-Capital Class model, the target instead loses 1 Crew Point if its Damage Rating is equaled or exceeded or 2 Crew Points if its Critical Rating is equaled or exceeded.

sharedRules.name: Deck Crews
sharedRules.description: A model with Deck Crew may roll a D6 during the Command Segment of its activation. On a result of 4, 5 or 6 take ONE previously Destroyed Wing and return it to a SRS Token that is currently on this model. The model’s maximum Wing complement and the maximum number of Wings in a SRS Token CANNOT be exceeded.

sharedRules.name: Difficult Target
sharedRules.description: If a Capital Class model makes a ranged attack against a Difficult Target, their Attack Dice will suffer a -1 ‘to hit’ modifier. Most commonly, this will mean that their Attack Dice will only score hits on a 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Elusive Target
sharedRules.description: An Elusive Target is only hit on a 6 by all Weapons Systems attacks from Capital Class models, and on a 5 or 6 by non-Capital Class models.

sharedRules.name: Nuclear Weapons
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons involved in an attack are Nuclear Weapons and the attack causes a Critical Hit, every model whose Flight Peg is within 4” of the target’s Flight Peg suffers an attack with HALF the Attack Dice of the initial attack.

sharedRules.name: Ops Center
sharedRules.description: If a model with the Ops Centre MAR is your Fleet Admiral’s Vessel you may take an additional TAC at no extra cost.

sharedRules.name: Protected Systems
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 from any rolls on a Targeted Strike Damage Table resulting from Direct Weapon Attacks against a model with Protected Systems.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description: The Fleet with the most models with the Scout Model Assigned Rule can redeploy any one of its Squadrons after all Squadrons have been deployed on the Game Board.

sharedRules.name: Second Assault
sharedRules.description: A model with the Second Assault MAR may launch TWO Boarding Assaults during a game, rather than one.

sharedRules.name: Secured Bulkheads
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 from any rolls on a Targeted Strike Damage Table resulting from Boarding Assaults against a model with Secured Bulkheads.

sharedRules.name: Special Forces
sharedRules.description: If all the models initiating a Boarding Assault have Special Forces, their Assault Point Dice receive a +1 ‘to hit’ modifier. If a model with Special Forces is the target of a Boarding Assault, the Assault Point Dice of the initiating models receive a -1 ‘to hit’ modifier.

sharedRules.name: Stealth Systems
sharedRules.description: Any Attack against a model with the Stealth Systems MAR must re-roll ALL successful rolls if any weapon in the Attack is firing from further than 20”. This re-roll is performed BEFORE any extra rolls for Exploding Dice, and before Hits are discounted by Shield Systems or Point Defense. Only ONE dice is re-rolled for any 6’s scored. The second result MUST be accepted.

sharedRules.name: Weapon Shielding
sharedRules.description: A model with the Weapon Shielding MAR only reduces the Attack Dice values of its Weapon Systems by ONE for every TWO points of Hull Damage it has suffered.
